desc_ko: Tongda Group Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company primarily engaged in the production of structural components for consumer electronics. The Company operates its business through two segments. The Consumer Electronics Components segment manufactures mobile phone casings and precision components, smart appliance panels, networking equipment and other consumer electronics products. The Household and Sporting Goods segment manufactures household durable goods, housewares and sporting goods. The segment's main products include sporting goods, outdoor leisure products, household power tools, indoor furniture and personal care products. The Company sells its products in domestic and overseas markets.
